gaps.sentence: She gave a moving ___ (PERFORM) of the sonata.
gaps.explanation: 'A performance of the sonata' — the act of performing.

gaps.sentence: There's a growing ___ (AWARE) of mental health issues.
The trainers were ___ (COMFORT) for long walks.
gaps.explanation: 'Were comfortable' — adjective; note the spelling: -able, not -ible.
The subject is 'botany'; a specialist is a 'botanist'.

gaps.sentence: He was praised for his ___ (BRAVE) during the fire.
gaps.explanation: 'His bravery' — quality noun; 'braveness' exists but is rare; 'bravery' is standard.

gaps.sentence: He suffers from ___ (SLEEP) since the accident.

gaps.explanation: 'A tendency to do something' — noun from tend.
